expected_level_description: You can: - follow office procedures for filing, ordering, and data entry - keep accurate records of your own work

You can: - produce well-formatted documents and presentations quickly and accurately - use spreadsheets to sort, filter, and summarise data - use collaboration tools to manage shared documents and versions
You can: - answer calls and emails politely and take accurate messages - pass enquiries to the right person
You can: - book meetings and rooms using the organisation's tools - send invitations and papers on time
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
You can: - treat colleagues, patients, and the public with dignity and respect - follow equality and inclusion policies
